title: CLAAS KGAA MBH | Devex
content: # CLAAS KGAA MBH. CLAAS Kommanditgesellschaft auf Aktien mbH engages in the manufacture and sale of agricultural equipment, industrial engineering, and production technology products worldwide. The company also supplies drive technology, hydraulics, and electronics for customers in the agricultural equipment, construction machinery, and municipal technology sectors, as well as products in automobile and aviation industries. CLAAS Kommanditgesellschaft auf Aktien mbH was founded in 1913 and is headquartered in Harsewinkel, Germany. The objective of the CLAAS foundation, set up by Helmut Claas in 1999, is the furtherance of developments in agricultural engineering and farming all around the world. The Helmut Claas Scholarship prize is awarded annually for outstanding projects or studies in the fields of agricultural engineering, general engineering or business management. The objective of the CLAAS Foundation is to promote science and research, as well as educate in the field of agricultural engineering and the related areas of engineering and economic science. title: Success Stories » Claas | Advancis
content: # **Claas** – A WinGuard Success Story. ## **Claas**. ## **The Challenge** – Security Management in agricultural Machinery Production. With corporate headquarters in Harsewinkel, Westphalia, CLAAS is the European market leader in combine harvesters. CLAAS is also a top performer in worldwide agricultural engineering with tractors, agricultural balers and green harvesting machinery. Harsewinkel is one of the most high-tech production plants of combines and agricultural choppers in the world. Furthermore, it encompasses the Technoparc, an exhibition center in which more than 30,000 interested visitors per year learn more about the agricultural machines of CLAAS and the company history. Video surveillance, intrusion detection as well as different building management technologies are indispensabale in order to guarantee the security of both employees and visitors. To be able to control all installed technical systems centrally via a unified operation interface, CLAAS has decided to use the Physical Security Information Management Platform WinGuard by Advancis. In case of an intrusion attempt, for example, the video image from the concerned area is immediately displayed in the control center.

title: Harsewinkel | CLAAS
content: We manufacture and assemble at over ten production plants worldwide. Our main factory in Harsewinkel works closely with our international sites—on equal footing—to ensure the highest quality standards at all times. Minus 4 degrees Fahrenheit and sleet: when Lisane Volkeri arrived at the CLAAS factory in Omaha, Nebraska, in January 2018, it was so cold that the entrance door had frozen shut. They had to prepare the Omaha factory for the full-scale production of a new series of the LEXION large combine harvester—model numbers 8900–5300—just a few months after the prototype had been assembled for the first time in Harsewinkel. The goal was to produce the machines in the American factory to exactly the same standards as the main production plant within two years—even though Omaha is nearly 4,400 miles away from Harsewinkel as the crow flies. Bernd Schapmann, manager of the main combine harvester assembly line in Harsewinkel, is responsible for ensuring that CLAAS quality standards are the same worldwide.
